findings.text: _program_fault re-implements the no-program judgement the repository already owns in reckon/crew/promotion_gate.py:647 with a second _SHELL_ASSIGNMENT regex and a first-word-only walk, so the shape is implemented twice and the two readers disagree on 'PYTHONPATH=x -m pytest tests/a.py', which this rule accepts and promotion_gate.py:697 refuses.
the all-assignments branch of _program_fault has no test, so a regression in that arm would leave every test green.
_run_gate_reading repeats the pointer-read block already in _run_was_armed_a_suite at reports.py:3193 (the same read_pointer on manifest_path.expanduser().parent.name).

the baseline_suite and after_suite command fields carry placeholders instead of the literal command that ran (that literal sits in importer-arms.sh), so a promotion reading them cannot re-run the pair.
